items.title: Tilly Norwood creator developing feature film 'Misaligned' starring the AI actor
items.excerpt: Particle 6, the UK company behind AI-generated actor Tilly Norwood, is developing 'Misaligned', its first feature to star the synthetic performer — a comedy-drama made on a hybrid model where directors, writers and editors work alongside AI specialists and traditional crew get AI training. A concrete look at how an AI-actor feature reshapes the production pipeline and the likeness debate.

items.title: Blender Studio Announces Ambitious Feature Film Project
items.excerpt: Blender Studio unveils 'Overgrown', an open-source, artist-centric large-scale animated feature explicitly built without cloud services or generative AI — pitched as a craft-forward counter-model to AI production pipelines. Design×AI relevance is via contrast/positioning rather than an AI tool; include as a craft-shift angle if a stronger news item is missing.

items.title: Meta's FREE "Banana Killer" & My AI Video Tool (Also Free!)
items.excerpt: Theoretically Media covers Meta's newly shipped free Muse Image model (positioned as a Nano-Banana rival) plus a free AI video tool, breaking down what the releases mean for AI filmmakers' toolkits. A fresh tool-news social item for the AI filmmaking workflow.
